notes.title: Akupara Games Celebrates 8 Year with Sales and Livestream
notes.notes:
Hey Akuparians! Guess what, it’s our birthday!,

Akupara Games is turning 8 years old and to celebrate, we have put [i]The Crow's Eye[/i] on sale for 68% off! Be sure to grab those deals, check out our lovely event page, and check out the sales! Maybe the game you’ve been waiting for is waiting for you here, with a crisp sale to match. 
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/akuparagames8thanniversarysale 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27145360/1b810888a3baac10bb6e47830de98f6cfaa88b2c.png[/img]

Also, to celebrate, we will be hosting a multi-hour stream with tons of activities, announcements, and more! Stream is starting at 11:45 PM PDT! We really hope to see you there - and here’s to another year of publishing your favorite indie games on the market
https://www.twitch.tv/akuparagames  

- Riv otter

notes.title: Akupara Games Publishes The Crow's Eye!
notes.notes:
Hey, test subjects!

I'm Buddy Sola, Community Manager of Akupara Games, and today we're excited to announce that Akupara Games will be taking over as publisher for [b]The Crow's Eye![/b] With titles like [b]Mutazione[/b] and [b]Whispering Willows[/b] under our belts, the experiments being conducted at the University of Medicine & Applied Sciences of Crowswood really caught our eye. 

[previewyoutube=jE6DzSdfors;full][/previewyoutube]

From now on, I'll be paying close attention to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/449510/discussions/]Steam Discussion forums[/url] for the game just to make sure that all the t's are crossed and i's are dotted, but if you run into any trouble while playing don't hesitate to reach out. You can contact me directly with any questions or concerns here: buddy [at] akuparagames [dot] com. 

Good luck on all your tests. I'm sure you won't need it. >:)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27145360/c1d1a5793c49013edeeecf9487a5fd328c68c1c8.gif[/img]

notes.title: Arima. A new adventure game from 3D2
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1112450/Arima/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27145360/1fc06114b0e874be39db55f2f6a2b3747c27f76d.gif[/img][/url]

Arima is a musical game which narrative and objectives are visually and sound marked. It is an Adventure set in a fantastic world. The player will live an auditory experience, where the mechanics revolve around music.
[list]
[*] Battle system characterized by rhythm.
[*] Innovative mechanics based on rhythm.
[*] Environmental narrative without any text.
[*] Eye-catching artistic visual.
[/list]

Go check it and add the game to your wishlist!

notes.title: The new free Extra Content for The Crow's Eye is now available!
notes.notes:
Meet Jack Meiwes, one of the missing students in Crowswood University, where other people also went missing and which led to a Police investigation.
 
The player will have to solve a series of puzzles... and the difficulty has been increased! In addition, each level displays a counter that tracks the time you're taking. Who will be the first to find out what happened to Jack Meiwes?
